description: Compute the directed [[wiki-link]] knowledge graph across all Markdown notes in the local vault, ranking the most referenced topics and identifying unresolved (dangling) wiki-links. Use this to map recurring entities/projects or audit broken links; prefer okf_vault_stats for high-level aggregate counts or okf_read_note to inspect one topic page. Read-only and 100% offline. Takes no parameters and returns JSON with totalNotes, totalEdges, topTopics, unresolvedLinks, and edges.
name: okf_topic_graph
title: Build Relational Wiki-Link Topic Graph
